allowed_cidrs.description: Tester public IPv4 CIDRs; never open the demo to all Internet.

validation.condition: ${length(var.allowed_cidrs) > 0 && alltrue([for c in var.allowed_cidrs : can(cidrnetmask(c)) && try(tonumber(split("/", c)[1]) >= 24, false)])}
validation.error_message: Provide at least one IPv4 CIDR with prefix /24 or narrower.

expires_at.description: UTC RFC3339 cleanup deadline. Tag only, NOT automatic deletion.

enable_workloads.description: Start verified API baseline; full mode additionally requires NLU/Bedrock/job acceptance checks.

validation.error_message: Images must be immutable digest references.

api_environment.description: Personal profile auth/CORS configuration. No secrets. Reserved infrastructure variables cannot be overridden.

bedrock_model_arn.description: One Seoul foundation-model ARN; no cross-region inference profiles.

cloud_contract_verified.description: Baseline: personal authentication and metrics isolation verified. Full: additionally verify adapter/job/quotas.

experiment_mode.description: This domain-free REST ingress currently supports api-baseline only; full is retained for compatibility but rejected by the deployment contract.

enable_cloudwatch_metrics.description: Opt in to LambdaOps M2 metrics (LambdaOps/Slash, slash-api/dev, 60 seconds) and the matching task-role permission. Does not start workloads or create alarms.

api_stage_name.description: Single URL path segment used by REST API, ALB routing and Grafana root_url.

validation.error_message: Use 1-32 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens for the stage.

cors_allowed_origin.description: Single browser origin for the baseline API, without a trailing slash. Not an authentication bypass.

validation.error_message: Use one HTTP(S) origin without path, wildcard, credentials or trailing slash.
